scene.title: Elastic collision of two balls
scene.summary: Two equal‑mass balls collide elastically, swapping their velocities while conserving momentum and kinetic energy.

beats.title: Approaching balls
beats.narration: Two equal‑mass balls move toward each other with speeds 3 m/s and 2 m/s.

beats.title: Collision point
beats.narration: They meet at the midpoint; the collision is elastic.

beats.title: Predict outcome
beats.narration: What happens to their velocities after the elastic collision?

check.question: After the collision, what are the velocities of the balls?
choices: They bounce back with same speeds
check.explain: In an elastic collision of equal masses, each ball takes the other's speed.

beats.title: Velocities exchanged
beats.narration: After an elastic collision of equal masses, they exchange velocities.
